name: Bishoujo Koumonka ~Onna no Ko no Onna no Ko ni yoru Onna no Ko no Tame no Oshiri no Oisha-san~
original_name: 美少女肛門科 ～女のコの女のコによる女のコのためのオシリのお医者さん～
source:
Open 365 days a year, 24 hours a day, easing the pain of any anus! (Offer limited to beautiful girls.)

The main character is a doctor with a childish face. His specialization is girls' buttocks, but girls don't want to be examined by a male doctor. So he writes a sign that the clinic is run by a female doctor, and the first girl shyly opens the door.

[Edited From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034522.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
全年365天、全天24小时营业，为任何肛门缓解疼痛！（仅限美少女。）

主人公是一名长着娃娃脸的医生，专门诊治少女的臀部问题。然而，女孩们都不愿接受男医生检查。于是，他挂出一块招牌，谎称诊所由女医生坐诊。很快，第一个女孩羞怯地推开了门。

[据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku_ga_sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]与[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034522.html]DLsite English[/url]内容编辑]
